## 1. Setup

This notebook prepares county-level HPMS data including lane miles and vmt

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)


library("dplyr") # data cleaning and handling
library("modelsummary") # outputing results where needed
library("sf") # handles shapefiles
library("units") # converts units of messure 
library("tidyverse")

# Load project configuration
source(here::here("R", "load_config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()

# Define HPMS input 


HPMS_dir <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$hpms$data_dir_HPMS
)

selected_states <- c(6, 41, 53, 4, 49, 32, 16, 35)
#selected_states <- c(41)

stopifnot(dir.exists(HPMS_dir))
```

## Import HPMS data for 1980 and clean the data saving as CSV

```{r}

subdir_1983 <- file.path(HPMS_dir, "1983")
files_1983 <- list.files(
  path = subdir_1983,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

files_1983

hpms_83_uni <- read.csv(files_1983[[2]])

hpms_83_sample <- read.csv(files_1983[[1]])

#taking only what we need from 1983 sample.  The sample is a perfect subset of the 
# universal data, and many variables are repeated so no reason to just merge them all
# for 1983 specifically the f_system does not exist and must be reconstructed from 
# the functional class variable.  Also calculating the percent commercial vehicles 
# by averaging the peak and off peak trucks since no breakdown into single or
# combination trucks are available 


# hpms_83_sample_for_merge <- hpms_83_sample %>%
#   group_by(SECTION.IDENTIFICATION) %>%
#   filter(n() > 1) %>%
#   ungroup()

hpms_83_sample_for_merge <-hpms_83_sample %>% 
  filter(STATE.FIPS.CODE %in% selected_states) %>%
    filter_out(is.na(AADT), 
             is.na(SECTION.GROUPED.LENGTH),
             is.na(COUNTY.FIPS.CODE),
             FEDERAL.AID.SYSTEM.STATUS!=1) %>% # For some reason built facilities are coded as 1, planned as 0 and not in the NHS as 8
  rename(Section.Identification = SECTION.IDENTIFICATION,
         county= COUNTY.FIPS.CODE)%>%
  mutate( 
          Merge_ID = case_when(
                               STATE.FIPS.CODE == 4 ~ str_c("AZ", Section.Identification),
                               STATE.FIPS.CODE == 6 ~ str_c("CA", Section.Identification), 
                               STATE.FIPS.CODE == 16 ~ str_c("ID", Section.Identification),
                               STATE.FIPS.CODE == 32 ~ str_c("NV", Section.Identification),
                               STATE.FIPS.CODE == 35 ~ str_c("NM", Section.Identification),
                               STATE.FIPS.CODE == 41 ~ str_c("OR", Section.Identification),
                               STATE.FIPS.CODE == 49 ~ str_c("UT", Section.Identification),
                               STATE.FIPS.CODE == 53 ~ str_c("WA", Section.Identification),
                               TRUE ~ NA ),
         f_system = case_when(FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==1 | FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==11 ~ 1,
                              FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==2 | FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==12 ~ 2,
                              FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==6 | FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==14 ~ 3,
                              FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==7 | FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==16 ~ 4,
                              FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==8 | FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==17 ~ 5,
                              FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==9 | FUNCTIONAL.CLASS==19 ~ 6),
         avg_truck = rowMeans(pick(PEAK.PERCENT.TRUCKS,OFF.PEAK.PERCENT.TRUCKS), na.rm=TRUE) ) %>%
  filter(f_system ==1) %>%
  select(Section.Identification,
         EXPANSION.FACTOR,
         PEAK.PERCENT.TRUCKS,
         OFF.PEAK.PERCENT.TRUCKS,
         FUNCTIONAL.CLASS, 
         f_system,
         avg_truck,
         Merge_ID,
         county)


hpms_83_uni_for_merge <- hpms_83_uni %>%  
  filter(State.FIPS.Code %in% selected_states) %>%
  filter_out(is.na(AADT), 
             is.na(Section.Grouped.Length),
             is.na(County.FIPS.Code),
             Federal.aid.System.Status!=1) %>% # For some reason built facilities are coded as 1, planned as 0 and not in the NHS as 8
  rename(county = County.FIPS.Code) %>%
  mutate(Merge_ID = case_when(
                               State.FIPS.Code == 4 ~ str_c("AZ", Section.Identification),
                               State.FIPS.Code == 6 ~ str_c("CA", Section.Identification), 
                               State.FIPS.Code == 16 ~ str_c("ID", Section.Identification),
                               State.FIPS.Code == 32 ~ str_c("NV", Section.Identification),
                               State.FIPS.Code == 35 ~ str_c("NM", Section.Identification),
                               State.FIPS.Code == 41 ~ str_c("OR", Section.Identification),
                               State.FIPS.Code == 49 ~ str_c("UT", Section.Identification),
                               State.FIPS.Code == 53 ~ str_c("WA", Section.Identification),
                               TRUE ~ NA ), 
                  f_system = case_when(Functional.Class==1 | Functional.Class==11 ~ 1,
                              Functional.Class==2 | Functional.Class==12 ~ 2,
                              Functional.Class==6 | Functional.Class==14 ~ 3,
                              Functional.Class==7 | Functional.Class==16 ~ 4,
                              Functional.Class==8 | Functional.Class==17 ~ 5,
                              Functional.Class==9 | Functional.Class==19 ~ 6),) %>%
  filter(f_system ==1)


# combine into final 1983 data
hpms_83 <- left_join(hpms_83_uni_for_merge, hpms_83_sample_for_merge, by=c("Merge_ID","county", "f_system"))
 

## create a new dataset to filter and mutate 
## preferred variables are those with Expansion factor but calculating the 
## non-expansion factor as well to run a robustness check as complex survey 
## designs (in this case stratified random samples) can have unpredictable 
## impacts on the SE in the analysis. 

measure_vars <- c(
  "lane_miles",
  "lane_miles_exp",
  "vmt",
  "vmt_exp",
  "vmt_com",
  "vmt_com_exp"
)


hpms_83_st<- hpms_83 %>%
  filter(State.FIPS.Code %in% selected_states) %>%
  rename(state = State.FIPS.Code, Perc_com = avg_truck,
         through_la = Number.of.Through.Lanes, miles = Section.Grouped.Length,
         expansion_factor=EXPANSION.FACTOR ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = 1983,
    urb = Rural.Urban != 1,
    ih  = f_system == 1,
    lane_miles        = through_la*miles,
    lane_miles_exp = lane_miles * expansion_factor,
    AADT             = as.integer(AADT),
    AADT_com          = AADT * Perc_com / 100,
    vmt               = AADT * miles,
    vmt_exp        = vmt * expansion_factor,
    vmt_com           = AADT_com * miles,
    vmt_com_exp    = vmt_com * expansion_factor
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(measure_vars),
      list(
        urb_ih  = ~ if_else( urb &  ih, ., 0),
        urb_mur = ~ if_else( urb & !ih, ., 0),
        rur_ih  = ~ if_else(!urb &  ih, ., 0),
        rur_mur = ~ if_else(!urb & !ih, ., 0)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  )


## collapse to the county


sum_vars <- names(hpms_83_st) |>
  grep(
    pattern = paste0(
      "^(",
      paste(measure_vars, collapse = "|"),
      ")(_urb_ih|_urb_mur|_rur_ih|_rur_mur)?$"
    ),
    value = TRUE
  )
 

hpms_83_st_ct <- hpms_83_st %>%
  group_by(state, county, year) %>%
  summarise(
    miles = sum(miles, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(all_of(measure_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(all_of(sum_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## drop the dataframes we do not want
 
#rm(hpms_83, hpms_83_st, hpms_83_uni, hpms_83_sample, hpms_83_sample_for_merge)



```
## Cleaning the 1993 data

```{r}

subdir_1993 <- file.path(HPMS_dir, "1993")
files_1993 <- list.files(
  path = subdir_1993,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

files_1993

 


hpms_93_uni <- read.csv(files_1993[[2]])

hpms_93_sample <- read.csv(files_1993[[1]])

#taking only what we need from 1993 sample.  The sample is a perfect subset of the 
# universal data, and many variables are repeated so no reason to just merge them all
hpms_93_sample_for_merge <-hpms_93_sample %>%
  filter(STATE %in% selected_states,
         NATIONAL.HIGHWAY.SYSTEM==1) %>%
  rename(f_system = GEN.FUNCTIONAL.SYSTEM) %>%
  mutate(Merge_ID = case_when(
                               STATE == 4 ~ str_c("AZ", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 6 ~ str_c("CA", SECTION.ID), 
                               STATE == 16 ~ str_c("ID", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 32 ~ str_c("NV", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 35 ~ str_c("NM", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 41 ~ str_c("OR", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 49 ~ str_c("UT", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 53 ~ str_c("WA", SECTION.ID),
                               TRUE ~ NA )) %>%
  filter(f_system==1) %>%
  select(f_system, Merge_ID, SECTION.ID, STANDARD.EXPANSION.FACTOR, COMB.COMM.VEH.AVERAGE, SINGLE.UNIT.VEH.AVERAGE) 

  
hpms_93_uni_for_merge <- hpms_93_uni %>%
  filter(STATE %in% selected_states,
         NATIONAL.HIGHWAY.SYSTEM==1) %>%
  rename(f_system = GEN.FUNCTIONAL.SYSTEM) %>%
    mutate(Merge_ID = case_when(
                               STATE == 4 ~ str_c("AZ", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 6 ~ str_c("CA", SECTION.ID), 
                               STATE == 16 ~ str_c("ID", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 32 ~ str_c("NV", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 35 ~ str_c("NM", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 41 ~ str_c("OR", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 49 ~ str_c("UT", SECTION.ID),
                               STATE == 53 ~ str_c("WA", SECTION.ID),
                               TRUE ~ NA )) %>%
  filter(f_system ==1)
 
# combine into final 2003 data

hpms_93 <- left_join(hpms_93_uni_for_merge, hpms_93_sample_for_merge, by=c("Merge_ID","f_system"))
 
## create a new dataset to filter and mutate 
## preferred variables are those with Expansion factor but calculating the 
## non-expansion factor as well to run a robustness check as complex survey 
## designs (in this case stratified random samples) can have unpredictable 
## impacts on the SE in the analysis. 

 
measure_vars <- c(
  "lane_miles",
  "lane_miles_exp",
  "vmt",
  "vmt_exp",
  "vmt_com",
  "vmt_com_exp"
)


# hpms_93 <- hpms_93 %>%
#   group_by_all() %>%
#   filter(n() > 1) %>%
#   ungroup()

hpms_93_st<- hpms_93 %>%
  filter(STATE %in% selected_states) %>%
  rename(state = STATE, county = COUNTY,  
         through_la = NUMBER.OF.LANES, miles = SECTION.LENGTH,
         expansion_factor=STANDARD.EXPANSION.FACTOR ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = 1993,
    Perc_com = SINGLE.UNIT.VEH.AVERAGE+COMB.COMM.VEH.AVERAGE,
    urb = RURAL.URBAN != 1,
    ih  = f_system == 1,
    lane_miles        = through_la*miles,
    lane_miles_exp = lane_miles * expansion_factor,
    AADT              = as.integer(AADT),
    AADT_com          = AADT * Perc_com / 100,
    vmt               = AADT * miles,
    vmt_exp        = vmt * expansion_factor,
    vmt_com           = AADT_com * miles,
    vmt_com_exp    = vmt_com * expansion_factor
  ) %>%
  filter_out(is.na(AADT), 
             is.na(miles),
             is.na(county),
             UNBUILT.FACILITY!=1) %>% # For some reason built facilities are coded as 1, planned as 0 and not in the NHS as 2
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(measure_vars),
      list(
        urb_ih  = ~ if_else( urb &  ih, ., 0),
        urb_mur = ~ if_else( urb & !ih, ., 0),
        rur_ih  = ~ if_else(!urb &  ih, ., 0),
        rur_mur = ~ if_else(!urb & !ih, ., 0)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  )


## collapse to the county


sum_vars <- names(hpms_93_st) |>
  grep(
    pattern = paste0(
      "^(",
      paste(measure_vars, collapse = "|"),
      ")(_urb_ih|_urb_mur|_rur_ih|_rur_mur)?$"
    ),
    value = TRUE
  )
 

hpms_93_st_ct <- hpms_93_st %>%
  group_by(state, county, year) %>%
  summarise(
    miles = sum(miles, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(all_of(measure_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(all_of(sum_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



#rm(hpms_93, hpms_93_st, hpms_93_sample_for_merge, hpms_93_sample, hpms_93_uni)
```

## 2003 HPMS data

```{r}

subdir_2003 <- file.path(HPMS_dir, "2003")
files_2003 <- list.files(
  path = subdir_2003,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

files_2003

hpms_03_uni <- read.csv(files_2003[[2]])

hpms_03_sample <- read.csv(files_2003[[1]])

hpms_03_sample_for_merge <-hpms_03_sample %>%
  filter(STATE_CODE %in% selected_states, NHS==1) %>%
  mutate(Merge_ID = case_when(
                               STATE_CODE == 4 ~ str_c("AZ", SECTION_ID),
                               STATE_CODE == 6 ~ str_c("CA", SECTION_ID), 
                               STATE_CODE == 16 ~ str_c("ID", SECTION_ID),
                               STATE_CODE == 32 ~ str_c("NV", SECTION_ID),
                               STATE_CODE == 35 ~ str_c("NM", SECTION_ID),
                               STATE_CODE == 41 ~ str_c("OR", SECTION_ID),
                               STATE_CODE == 49 ~ str_c("UT", SECTION_ID),
                               STATE_CODE == 53 ~ str_c("WA", SECTION_ID),
                               TRUE ~ NA )) %>%
  rename(Section_ID = SECTION_ID, f_system = GF_SYSTEM) %>%
  filter(f_system==1) %>%
  select(f_system, Merge_ID, Section_ID, STD_EXP_FACTOR, PERC_COMBINATION, PERC_SINGLE_UNIT)

hpms_03_uni_for_merge <- hpms_03_uni %>%
  rename(f_system = GF_System) %>% 
  filter(State_Code %in% selected_states, NHS==1) %>%
    mutate(Merge_ID = case_when(
                               State_Code == 4 ~ str_c("AZ", Section_ID),
                               State_Code == 6 ~ str_c("CA", Section_ID), 
                               State_Code == 16 ~ str_c("ID", Section_ID),
                               State_Code == 32 ~ str_c("NV", Section_ID),
                               State_Code == 35 ~ str_c("NM", Section_ID),
                               State_Code == 41 ~ str_c("OR", Section_ID),
                               State_Code == 49 ~ str_c("UT", Section_ID),
                               State_Code == 53 ~ str_c("WA", Section_ID),
                               TRUE ~ NA )) %>%
  filter(f_system==1)



# combine into final 2003 data
hpms_03 <- left_join(hpms_03_uni_for_merge, hpms_03_sample_for_merge, by=c("Merge_ID", "f_system"))


measure_vars <- c(
  "lane_miles",
  "lane_miles_exp",
  "vmt",
  "vmt_exp",
  "vmt_com",
  "vmt_com_exp"
)


hpms_03_st<- hpms_03 %>%
  filter(State_Code %in% selected_states) %>%
  rename(state = State_Code, county = County_Code, 
         through_la = Through_Lanes, miles = Section__Length,
         expansion_factor=STD_EXP_FACTOR ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = 2003,
    Perc_com = PERC_COMBINATION+PERC_SINGLE_UNIT,
    urb = Rural.Urban != 1,
    ih  = f_system == 1,
    miles = as.integer(miles),
    lane_miles        = through_la*miles,
    lane_miles_exp = lane_miles * expansion_factor,
    AADT              = as.integer(AADT),
    AADT_com          = AADT * Perc_com / 100,
    vmt               = AADT * miles,
    vmt_exp        = vmt * expansion_factor,
    vmt_com           = AADT_com * miles,
    vmt_com_exp    = vmt_com * expansion_factor
  ) %>%
  filter_out(is.na(AADT), 
             is.na(miles),
             is.na(county),
             Unbuilt_Facility!=1) %>% # For some reason built faculties are coded as 1, planned as 0 and not in the NHS as 2
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(measure_vars),
      list(
        urb_ih  = ~ if_else( urb &  ih, ., 0),
        urb_mur = ~ if_else( urb & !ih, ., 0),
        rur_ih  = ~ if_else(!urb &  ih, ., 0),
        rur_mur = ~ if_else(!urb & !ih, ., 0)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  )


## collapse to the county


sum_vars <- names(hpms_03_st) |>
  grep(
    pattern = paste0(
      "^(",
      paste(measure_vars, collapse = "|"),
      ")(_urb_ih|_urb_mur|_rur_ih|_rur_mur)?$"
    ),
    value = TRUE
  )
 

hpms_03_st_ct <- hpms_03_st %>%
  group_by(state, county, year) %>%
  summarise(
    miles = sum(miles, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(all_of(measure_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(all_of(sum_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 2013 

```{r}

subdir_2013 <- file.path(HPMS_dir, "2013")

 

file_list_2013 <- list.files(path = subdir_2013, pattern = "*shp", full.names = TRUE)

shapefile_2013_list <- lapply(file_list_2013, read_sf)
hpms_13 <- sf::st_as_sf(data.table::rbindlist(shapefile_2013_list,  fill=TRUE))
 

# all states

hpms_13 <- hpms_13 %>%
  group_by_all() %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()


hpms_st13 <- hpms_13 %>%
  mutate(COUNTY_ID = county_cod, URBAN_ID = urban_code ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(URBAN_ID),!is.na(aadt_vn), !is.na(through_la)) %>%
  filter_out(facility_t==7)  # these are planned but not yet built facilities 
 

hpms_st13$length_m <- st_length(hpms_st13)

hpms_st13$length_miles <- set_units(hpms_st13$length_m, "mi")

hpms_st13 <- hpms_st13 %>% mutate(is_sample = ifelse(is.na(is_sample), 0, is_sample))

measure_vars_13 <- c( # I do not yet have commercial information for 2013
  "lane_miles",
  "lane_miles_exp",
  "vmt",
  "vmt_exp"
)


hpms_13_st <- hpms_st13 %>%
  rename(RouteID = id, 
         AADT = aadt_vn,
         f_system = f_system_v, 
         county = county_cod, 
         state=state_code) %>%
  mutate(year = 2013,
         miles = end_point - begin_poin,
         through_la = as.numeric(through_la),
         lane_miles = miles * through_la,
         lane_miles_exp = if_else(!is.na(expansion_), miles * through_la * expansion_, miles*through_la),
         vmt = AADT*miles, 
         vmt_exp = if_else(!is.na(expansion_), AADT*miles*expansion_, AADT*miles),
         urb = urban_code != 99999,
         ih  = f_system == 1)%>%
    mutate(
    across(
      all_of(measure_vars_13),
      list(
        urb_ih  = ~ if_else( urb &  ih, ., 0),
        urb_mur = ~ if_else( urb & !ih, ., 0),
        rur_ih  = ~ if_else(!urb &  ih, ., 0),
        rur_mur = ~ if_else(!urb & !ih, ., 0)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  )

         
 sum_vars <- names(hpms_13_st) |>
  grep(
    pattern = paste0(
      "^(",
      paste(measure_vars, collapse = "|"),
      ")(_urb_ih|_urb_mur|_rur_ih|_rur_mur)?$"
    ),
    value = TRUE
  )
 

hpms_13_st_ct <- hpms_13_st %>%
  group_by(state, county, year) %>%
  summarise(
    miles = sum(miles, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(all_of(measure_vars_13), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(all_of(sum_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

 
 

hpms_13_st_ct <- as.data.frame(hpms_13_st_ct) %>% select(-geometry)

rm(hpms_st13, hpms_13)

```
## 2023 data 
```{r}

subdir_2023 <- file.path(HPMS_dir, "2023")

## have to hand-code the 2023 year data, the file names do not match with the state codes
## or even have a consistent pattern that could be wildcard searched

hpms_23_ca <- st_read(file.path(subdir_2023, "a00000011.gdbtable"))

hpms_23_nm <- st_read(file.path(subdir_2023, "a00000026.gdbtable"))

hpms_23_nv <- st_read(file.path(subdir_2023, "a00000034.gdbtable"))

hpms_23_az <- st_read(file.path(subdir_2023, "a00000038.gdbtable"))

hpms_23_id <- st_read(file.path(subdir_2023, "a00000039.gdbtable"))

hpms_23_ut <- st_read(file.path(subdir_2023, "a0000002b.gdbtable"))

hpms_23_wa <- st_read(file.path(subdir_2023, "a0000002c.gdbtable"))

hpms_23_or <- st_read(file.path(subdir_2023, "a0000002e.gdbtable"))

feilds <-c("F_SYSTEM" = "Field6", "FACILITY_TYPE"="Field7", "URBAN_ID"="Field8", "COUNTY_ID"= "Field14", "OWNERSHIP"="Field15" )

hpms_23_nm <- rename(hpms_23_nm, feilds)

list_23 <- list(hpms_23_ca, hpms_23_az, hpms_23_nm, hpms_23_nv, hpms_23_or, hpms_23_wa, hpms_23_ut, hpms_23_id)

hpms_23 <- sf::st_as_sf(data.table::rbindlist(list_23,  fill=TRUE, ignore.attr=TRUE))

hpms_23 <- hpms_23 %>%
  group_by_all() %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()


#converting the NULLS to NA 
hpms_23 <- hpms_23 %>% 
  mutate(IS_SAMPLE = ifelse(IS_SAMPLE=="NULL", 0, IS_SAMPLE),
                              F_SYSTEM = ifelse(F_SYSTEM=="NULL", NA, F_SYSTEM),
                              COUNTY_ID = ifelse(COUNTY_ID=="NULL", NA, COUNTY_ID),
                              URBAN_ID = ifelse(URBAN_ID=="NULL", NA, URBAN_ID),
                              AADT = ifelse(AADT=="NULL", NA, AADT),
                              FACILITY_TYPE = ifelse(FACILITY_TYPE=="NULL", NA, FACILITY_TYPE),
                              THROUGH_LANES = ifelse(THROUGH_LANES=="NULL", NA, THROUGH_LANES),
                              AADT_COMBINATION = ifelse(AADT_COMBINATION=="NULL", NA, AADT_COMBINATION),
                              AADT_SINGLE_UNIT = ifelse(AADT_SINGLE_UNIT=="NULL", NA, AADT_SINGLE_UNIT))

#filtering out the NA's
hpms_st23 <- hpms_23 %>%
  mutate(COUNTY_ID = as.numeric(COUNTY_ID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(URBAN_ID),
         !is.na(AADT),
         !is.na(F_SYSTEM),
         !is.na(AADT_SINGLE_UNIT),
         !is.na(AADT_COMBINATION),
         !is.na(FACILITY_TYPE),
         FACILITY_TYPE!=7) # planned but not yet built facilities 
 

#https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/policyinformation/hpms/softwareguide/hpms_software_guide.pdf
# in the above document they specify that lane miles are (end point - begin point) * through-lanes
# the calculation via st_length runs into problems since there are curved segments

# hpms_st23$length_m <- st_length(hpms_st23)
# hpms_st23$length_miles <- set_units(hpms_st23$length_m, "mi")

#creating the data for actual use and select down to 

hpms_st23 <- hpms_st23 %>%
  st_drop_geometry()  

hpms_st23 <- as.data.frame(hpms_st23)
 
measure_vars_23 <- c( ## missing expansion factors currently
  "lane_miles",
  "vmt",
  "vmt_com"
)

hpms_23_st <- hpms_st23 %>%
  filter(!is.na(COUNTY_ID)) %>%
  rename(f_system=F_SYSTEM, county = COUNTY_ID, state = StateID) %>%
  mutate(year = 2023,
         f_system = as.numeric(f_system),
         urb = URBAN_ID!=99999,
         ih= f_system ==1,
         miles = EndPoint - BeginPoint,
         through_la = as.numeric(THROUGH_LANES),
         lane_miles = miles * through_la,
         AADT = as.numeric(AADT),
         AADT_SINGLE_UNIT = as.numeric(AADT_SINGLE_UNIT),
         AADT_COMBINATION = as.numeric(AADT_COMBINATION),
         AADT_com = AADT_COMBINATION+AADT_SINGLE_UNIT,
         through_la = as.numeric(THROUGH_LANES),
         lane_miles = miles * through_la,
         vmt = AADT * miles,
         vmt_com = AADT_com * miles) %>%
    mutate(
    across(
      all_of(measure_vars_23),
      list(
        urb_ih  = ~ if_else( urb &  ih, ., 0),
        urb_mur = ~ if_else( urb & !ih, ., 0),
        rur_ih  = ~ if_else(!urb &  ih, ., 0),
        rur_mur = ~ if_else(!urb & !ih, ., 0)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  )

         
 sum_vars <- names(hpms_23_st) |>
  grep(
    pattern = paste0(
      "^(",
      paste(measure_vars, collapse = "|"),
      ")(_urb_ih|_urb_mur|_rur_ih|_rur_mur)?$"
    ),
    value = TRUE
  )
 

hpms_23_st_ct <- hpms_23_st %>%
  group_by(state, county, year) %>%
  summarise(
    miles = sum(miles, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(all_of(measure_vars_23), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(all_of(sum_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
         
 

rm(list_23, hpms_23_ca, hpms_23_az, hpms_23_nm, hpms_23_nv, hpms_23_or, hpms_23_wa, hpms_23_ut, hpms_23_id, feilds, hpms_23)

```


## Merge the county data files together
```{r, results = FALSE, warning=FALSE}

hpms_st_ct <- bind_rows(hpms_83_st_ct, hpms_93_st_ct, hpms_03_st_ct, hpms_13_st_ct, hpms_23_st_ct)

hpms_st_ct <- hpms_st_ct %>%
  mutate(FIPS = state*1000+county) %>%
  rename(statefp= state,
         countyfp = county)
  
```




## Export CSV

```{r}

# Create output directory if it does not exist
dir.create(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Construct output file path
output_file <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$hpms$output_file
)

# Write CSV
write.csv(
  hpms_st_ct,
  output_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Dataset saved to:", output_file, "\n")

# Read the CSV back for verification
exported_data <- read.csv(output_file)

# Verify dimensions and column names
stopifnot(
  nrow(exported_data) == nrow(hpms_st_ct),
  identical(names(exported_data), names(hpms_st_ct))
)

cat("Export verification passed.\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(exported_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(exported_data), "\n")

#clean up the memory
rm(list = ls())

 


```
